title: Export Packet Dissections: C Arrays: Add optional index array
description:
Add print options to Export Packet Dissections to support adding
an index array (null terminated) for the packet arrays. While at
it, add an option to disable the secondary data sources. Default
to the previous options.

Fix #19616

+* The Export Packet Dissections C Arrays output gained an option to add an index
+  array for the arrays of data sources. Also, there is an option to omit secondary
